# REQ: LANG-431 LANG-432 LANG-433 LANG-434
CC ?= gcc
CFLAGS := -O2 -Wall
SRCS = $(wildcard src/*.c)
OBJS = $(patsubst %.c,%.o,$(SRCS))
VERSION = "1.0"

.PHONY: all clean

all: app

app: $(OBJS)
	$(CC) $(CFLAGS) -o $@ $^

%.o: %.c
	$(CC) $(CFLAGS) -c $< -o ${@}

ifeq ($(DEBUG),1)
CFLAGS += -g
else
CFLAGS += -DNDEBUG
endif

clean:
	rm -f $(OBJS) app # remove build output
	@echo 'done $$HOME'
